description: Referral System - Each user gets a unique referral code on signup. When someone signs up with their code, both get 7-day fine waiver. Track referrals in a new table. Show referral count + leaderboard. Deep link support via Edge Function.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/006_referrals.sql - New table `referrals` with columns: id (uuid PK), referrer_id (uuid FK users), referee_id (uuid FK users, nullable until signup completes), code (text unique not null), status (text: pending/completed/rewarded), reward_type (text default 'fine_waiver_7d'), created_at (timestamptz). Add a `referral_code` column to `users` table (text unique). Create index on referrals(referrer_id) and referrals(code). Add RLS policies: users can read their own referrals, service_role can insert/update. Create a trigger function `generate_referral_code()` that generates code on user insert (first 4 chars of name uppercased + 4 random digits). Update `handle_new_auth_user()` to call it.

Create supabase/functions/apply-referral/index.ts - Edge Function that: (1) requireUser, (2) takes `code` from body, (3) looks up the referral code in users table, (4) verifies referee hasn't already used a code, (5) inserts a referral record with status='completed', (6) grants 7-day fine waiver to BOTH users by updating blocked_apps_config.unlock_granted_until to now()+7days with unlock_source='referral_reward', (7) records notification event for both users.

Create supabase/functions/get-referral-stats/index.ts - Edge Function that: (1) requireUser, (2) returns user's referral_code, total referral count, and top 10 leaderboard (users with most completed referrals). Uses adminClient to query across users.

Create supabase/functions/referral-redirect/index.ts - A simple Edge Function that handles GET requests for deep links. When called with ?code=XXXX, returns an HTML page with a meta redirect to the app's deep link scheme or app store URL. This enables repgate.app/join/CODE links.
Create lib/models/referral_model.dart - ReferralModel with fields: id, referrerName, refereeId, code, status, createdAt. Factory fromMap constructor.

Create lib/services/referral_service.dart - Service class with methods: (1) `getMyReferralStats()` - calls get-referral-stats Edge Function, returns code + count + leaderboard, (2) `applyReferralCode(String code)` - calls apply-referral Edge Function, (3) `shareReferralLink(String code)` - uses share_plus to share 'Join RepGate with my code: CODE. Download: repgate.app/join/CODE' message.

Create lib/screens/profile/referral_screen.dart - Screen showing: (1) User's own referral code prominently displayed with a copy button, (2) Share button that shares the referral link via share_plus, (3) Referral count (e.g., '5 friends joined'), (4) Leaderboard list showing top referrers with their names and counts. Use SoftCard, AppColors, existing widget patterns.

Add referral code input field to the onboarding flow or a post-signup prompt - Create a simple dialog/bottom sheet in the auth flow (lib/screens/auth/) that asks 'Have a referral code?' with a text field and Apply button. This should be optional and skippable.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 006_referrals.sql creates the referrals table, adds referral_code to users, updates handle_new_auth_user trigger
apply-referral Edge Function validates code, prevents self-referral and double-use, grants 7-day waiver to both parties
get-referral-stats returns user code, count, and leaderboard
ReferralScreen shows code, share button, count, and leaderboard
All new Edge Functions follow the invoke() + _shared/common.ts pattern
Referral code input is available during/after signup flow
verification: Verify SQL migration is syntactically valid (no unclosed statements, proper FK references)
Verify Edge Function TypeScript files import correctly from _shared/common.ts
Verify new Dart files have valid syntax and correct imports
findings: All files pass structural validation (brace/paren balancing, SQL dollar-quote matching). No Flutter or Deno CLI available for runtime verification. The referral-redirect Edge Function deliberately bypasses the invoke() wrapper to handle GET requests for deep links. share_plus API uses Share.share() consistent with existing share_service.dart pattern.
